plan.policy: After Q3 matched-placement collection terminates and its owned server stops, test increasing -ngl at unchanged 65536 context/F16 KV with MTP OFF. -ngl includes the output layer. Stop after a failed probe, missing GPU telemetry, RAM guard or crossing the configured 512MiB reserve below this GPU's 8188MiB. Pick the largest successfully tested admissible count, not a proven global maximum. Measure fixed 256-token x3 prompts x3 repeats throughput at that placement separately from the baseline. Short probes do not prove long-context quality or long-generation throughput. No quality scores are reassigned to a different placement.
